pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 11-unit (Our Precious Planet) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: 2-tur shart gap.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 11-UNIT NAZARIYA + MAShQLAR (54-bet, PDF 53). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '11', sarlavha: 'Conditionals Type 2'. Och pushti ramka.

'Conditionals Type 2': • Conditionals Type 2 express an imaginary or improbable situation which is unlikely to happen in the present or future. They are formed as follows: if-clause: If + past simple → main clause: would/could/might + bare infinitive. 'If I had more free time, I would take up basketball. (I don't have much free time now, so it is unlikely that I will take up basketball. - improbable situation)' • We can use were instead of was for all persons. 'If I were rich, I would travel around the world.' • We use if I were you ... when we want to give advice. 'If I were you, I would stop eating junk food.'

'Conditionals Type 2':
1) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense, as in the example.' 1 If someone played (play) loud music late at night, I would complain. 2 If Tom won the lottery, he ...... (buy) a house in the country. 3 If she ...... (study) harder, she would do better in her exams. 4 If I ...... (buy) this jacket for you, would you wear it? 5 If the team ...... (try) harder, they would win the championship. 6 If Bill drove to work, he ...... (get) there faster. 7 If I ...... (be) you, I would buy her a scarf. 8 If we moved house, I ...... (miss) my friends. 9 If Julie ...... (have) time, she would learn how to type. 10 If they didn't like Chinese food, they ...... (not/order) from the Chinese restaurant all the time. 11 If Tom ...... (be) taller, he would become a basketball player. 12 If my father was a baker, we ...... (eat) fresh croissants every day.
2) 'Look at the prompts below and use them to make sentences, as in the example.' 1 repair my bicycle → ride it: If I repaired my bicycle, I could ride it. 2 exercise more often → be fit 3 get lost → ask for help 4 find somewhere better to live → move house 5 buy a camera → take pictures 6 travel to New York → visit the Statue of Liberty 7 go camping → take my sleeping bag 8 need money → ask my parents 9 won £1,000,000 → stop working 10 it be cold → wear my coat 11 break arm → go to hospital 12 have a dog → name it Irma 13 have a big garden → have barbecues every weekend 14 know how to drive → buy a car

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '54'.

exercises.instructionEn: Conditionals Type 2 express an imaginary or improbable situation which is unlikely to happen in the present or future: If + past simple → would/could/might + bare infinitive. If I had more free time, I would take up basketball. (I don't have much free time now, so it is unlikely that I will take up basketball - improbable situation.) We can use were instead of was for all persons: If I were rich, I would travel around the world. We use if I were you ... when we want to give advice: If I were you, I would stop eating junk food.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-tur shart gap hozir yoki kelajakda bo'lishi EHTIMOLDAN YIROQ, XAYOLIY vaziyatni bildiradi: If + past simple → would/could/might + fe'l asosiy shakli. Agar bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq bo'lganda, basketbol bilan shug'ullanardim. (Hozir bo'sh vaqtim kam, shuning uchun basketbol bilan shug'ullanishim ehtimoldan yiroq - xayoliy vaziyat.) Hamma shaxsda was o'rniga were ishlatish mumkin: Agar boy bo'lganimda, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim. 'If I were you ...' maslahat berish uchun: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, zararli taom yeyishni to'xtatardim.
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAP - XAYOLIY VAZIYAT.

  IF + PAST SIMPLE, + WOULD /
  COULD / MIGHT + FE'L

  If I HAD more free time, I WOULD
  TAKE UP basketball.
  (aslida vaqtim yo'q - xayol)

  ⚠ 'if' qismida O'TGAN ZAMON,
  lekin ma'no HOZIR/KELAJAK!
  ⚠ 'would' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda.


1-TUR bilan FARQI:

  1-tur: If I HAVE time, I WILL
    go. (real - balki boradi)
  2-tur: If I HAD time, I WOULD
    go. (xayoliy - vaqtim yo'q)


WERE - HAMMA ShAXSDA:

  If I WERE rich, I would travel
  around the world.
  (If I was rich - og'zaki nutqda
  ham mumkin)


MASLAHAT - IF I WERE YOU:

  IF I WERE YOU, I would stop
  eating junk food.
  (Sening o'rningda bo'lsam ...)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  '-sa edi ... -ardi':
  'boy bo'lsam edi, sayohat
  qilardim'.


⚠ 'TO TAKE UP':

  = (yangi mashg'ulot) boshlamoq.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
IF QISMI → PAST SIMPLE; BOSh GAP
  → WOULD + FE'L.

  1 played (NAMUNA - if qismi)
  2 would buy (bosh gap)
  3 studied (if)
  4 bought (if)
  5 tried (if)
  6 would get (bosh)
  7 were (if - If I were you)
  8 would miss (bosh)
  9 had (if)
  10 wouldn't order (bosh, inkor)
  11 were / was (if)
  12 would eat (bosh)


⚠ 'TO COMPLAIN':

  = shikoyat qilmoq.


⚠ 'THE CHAMPIONSHIP':

  = chempionat.

exercises.explanationUz:
IF I + PAST SIMPLE, I WOULD /
  COULD + FE'L.

  Noto'g'ri fe'llar: get lost →
  got lost; find → found; buy →
  bought; go → went; won → won;
  be → were/was; break → broke;
  have → had; know → knew

  ⚠ 'could' - imkoniyat (qila
  olardim); 'would' - natija
  (qilardim).


⚠ 'TO GET LOST':

  = adashib qolmoq.


⚠ 'THE STATUE OF LIBERTY':

  = Ozodlik haykali (Nyu-York).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 If I repaired my bicycle, I could ride it.
modelAnswers: 1 If I repaired my bicycle, I could ride it.
2 If I exercised more often, I would be fit.
3 If I got lost, I would ask for help.
4 If I found somewhere better to live, I would move house.
5 If I bought a camera, I could take pictures.
6 If I travelled to New York, I would visit the Statue of Liberty.
7 If I went camping, I would take my sleeping bag.
8 If I needed money, I would ask my parents.
9 If I won £1,000,000, I would stop working.
10 If it were cold, I would wear my coat.
11 If I broke my arm, I would go to hospital.
12 If I had a dog, I would name it Irma.
13 If I had a big garden, I would have barbecues every weekend.
14 If I knew how to drive, I would buy a car.
modelAnswersUz: 4 Yashash uchun yaxshiroq joy topganimda, ko'chardim.
6 Nyu-Yorkka sayohat qilganimda, Ozodlik haykalini ziyorat qilardim.
12 Itim bo'lganda, unga Irma deb ism qo'yardim.
13 Katta bog'im bo'lganda, har dam olish kuni barbekyu qilardim.

patterns.formula: If + KIM + V2, KIM + would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If Tom won the lottery, he would buy a house in the country.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar Tom lotereya yutganda, qishloqda uy sotib olardi.

patterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would buy her a scarf.
patterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, unga ro'mol sotib olardim.

patterns.formula: If I + V2 ..., I could + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I repaired my bicycle, I could ride it.

patterns.formula: If + KIM + V2, would + KIM + FE'L?
patterns.exampleEn: If I bought this jacket for you, would you wear it?
patterns.exampleUz: Senga bu kurtkani sotib olganimda, kiyarmiding?
